_comment: Three notes and nothing else: no raw/, no structure/, no inbox/, and a SCHEMA.md that declares no vocabulary. Nothing is wrong with it, and six checks have no surface to read at all — they must be reported as not applicable by name, which is the difference between a vault this small being clean and a vault this small being unexamined. ZK003 is one of the six, and deliberately so: a vault that declares no vocabulary is not judged against one.
